title: Server Teleport without proxy
description: /server (servername) to switch server like Velocity/Bungeecord proxy but just with 2 servers !
snippet:
command /server <text>:
    trigger:
        if arg-1 is "servername":
            make console execute command "execute as %player% run transfer (ip)"
        else:
            send "&cUnknown server. Available servers: &eservername" to player

on tab complete of "/server":
    set tab completions for position 1 to "servername"
